description: Fresh Linear bootstrap for ANQR 1.0 foundation work. Projects represent streams or package families; concrete ownership is tracked by labels.

projects.name: Foundation & Governance
projects.description: Bootstrap doctrine, migration control, and repo-level governance.

projects.name: Documentation & Doctrine
projects.description: Canonical docs, archive policy, and operating-model rewrite work.

projects.name: Harness & Automation
projects.description: harness/ops, systemd runtime, queue control, runner, and automation health.

projects.name: Web Experience
projects.description: apps/web delivery, UX, i18n, content, and browser-facing user flows.

projects.name: API & MCP Delivery
projects.description: Netlify HTTP API, MCP delivery, contracts, route policy, and deployment hardening.

projects.name: QR Engine & Core Packages
projects.description: contracts, domain, application, platform, and reusable QR package work.

projects.name: Mobile Convergence
projects.description: android, ios, apps/mobile, and the truth of the mobile 1.0 claim.

projects.name: Observability & Reliability
projects.description: Sentry, runtime correctness, alarms, error budgets, and hardening.

projects.name: Release Readiness
projects.description: Launch gating, release proof, rollout readiness, and signoff coordination.

projects.name: Growth / SEO / Discoverability
projects.description: SEO, sitemap, attribution, public discovery, and growth surfaces.

projects.name: Compliance / Privacy
projects.description: legal surfaces, privacy posture, consent, and compliance-owned tasks.

projects.name: Incidents / Ops
projects.description: operator incidents, postmortems, and urgent runtime work.

states.name: Backlog
states.usage: Not yet ready for active execution.

states.name: In Review
states.usage: Awaiting evidence review or merge validation.

states.name: Human Review
states.usage: Needs a human decision for secrets, approvals, legal, store, billing, or launch-claim changes.

states.name: Canceled
states.usage: Superseded or intentionally dropped with explanation.

humanOnlyTriggers: secret rotation or secret disclosure risk
